label: Молчать
description: A 10-sentence conjugation card for молчать (to be silent).

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: First-person singular present. Молчать is imperfective and takes -чу after the stem ч. 'Молчу' means I keep silent right now, with a reason given.
Strategic focus: Second-person singular present. 'Молчишь' shows the -ишь ending. 'Всё время' marks a habitual silence, the core sense of молчать.

missions.phrase: Он молчит и смотрит в пол.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Third-person singular present. 'Молчит' takes the -ит ending. The verb describes an ongoing state of keeping quiet.
Strategic focus: First-person plural present. 'Молчим' uses the -им ending. The purpose clause 'чтобы не мешать' explains the deliberate silence.
Strategic focus: Third-person plural present. 'Молчат' closes the present set with the -ат ending. 'Целый час' stresses the durative silence.
Strategic focus: Past, masculine. 'Молчал' is the masculine -л past of молчать. 'Весь вечер' brings out the imperfective, lasting silence.
Strategic focus: Past, feminine. 'Молчала' adds the feminine -ла ending. 'Долго' stresses the sustained, durative quiet.
Strategic focus: Past, plural. 'Молчали' is the plural -ли past, shared by all genders. It pairs silence with attentive listening.
Strategic focus: Imperative, singular. 'Молчи' is the informal command of молчать. Paired with 'слушай', it gives a firm order to stay quiet.
Strategic focus: Infinitive use. 'Молчать' stays in the dictionary form after evaluative 'лучше'. The imperfective infinitive states a general truth.
